Source: IFRC DREF Operation MDRNG046 Nigeria Cholera Outbreak 5 August 2026
Description: IFRC DREF operation MDRNG046, Nigeria Cholera Outbreak, dated 5 August 2026, retrieved through the IFRC GO API. As of epi week 29 of 2026 Nigeria had reported 44,129 cumulative suspected cases nationally including 5,257 new that week; Borno State was the epicentre with more than 35,000 cumulative suspected cases, about 99 per cent of the weekly national caseload, and 20 of its 27 LGAs affected. The five most affected LGAs - Maiduguri Metropolitan Council, Jere, Monguno, Konduga and Mafa - together account for approximately 92 per cent of the state caseload and cover an estimated 2,151,990 people. Additional transmission is reported in Kukawa, Magumeri, Bama, Biu, Kaga, Kwaya Kusar, Gubio, Mobbar, Ngala, Dikwa, Damboa, Nganzai, Gwoza, Hawul and Marte. Monguno and Kukawa are named as the LGAs with increasing trends. In Plateau State the named affected LGAs are Jos North and Mangu. Borno suspected cases are up 1,052 per cent and deaths up 186 per cent on the same period of 2025. The document gives NO per-LGA case counts, only percentage allocations of the response.
